method: Fresh Chromium contexts, 1280x800, deviceScaleFactor1, software SwiftShader graphics, 20 racers, first five rendered countdown frames. GL submissions include main scene and shadow passes. RAF was throttled equally in both versions.
limitations: Draw counts are measured. Software render callback times did not show a consistent gain; these results do not establish actual iPhone FPS. Small submitted-triangle variation follows combined mesh frustum bounds; model triangle counts and silhouettes are unchanged.
geometryValidation: All 60 unique rolled models preserve vertex positions, normals, bounds, triangle counts, diffuse colors and mutable rage material references. Animated trick and ride rigs remain independent.
